# M2: Coordinator lease, reconcile, re-parent, engine restart, watchdog

Part of sheepdog-factory, phases 1–4. Read the design (the design repo's docs/sheepdog-factory-design.md) and field notes (the design repo's docs/factory-field-notes.md) first; docs/dev/factory/engine-audit.md (SDF-1's line audit) once it exists.

## Goal and scope
Design section 5 'Watchdog, recovery, identity' with notes 53–55 as tests: a lease in the project record; reconcile to exactly one coordinator per project in the repo folder with no owner message; re-parent workers whose parent is dead and deliver held news; wakes keyed by folder; restart in engine code (replaces restart.sh); 'working with no child and no output for 20 min' is stuck. Split into lease/restart and reconcile/re-parent if it passes ~600 lines.

## Note
This brief may be finished by the Assistant (herdr-task edit) before the task starts. Waits on: SDF-13.

## Rules for this repo (sheepdog)
- Read AGENTS.md and docs/dev/architecture.md first. Use the words in docs/dev/glossary.md.
- Conventional Commits (`docs(factory): …`, `feat(factory): …`). No session links, no Co-authored-by trailers.
- Never print or commit secrets, `.env` files or unredacted logs. No real names, phone numbers or private addresses in anything you commit (say "the owner", never a name). The repo will be public.
- Docs: developer docs live under docs/dev/; keep relative links working; `go test ./internal/docscheck` must pass. Show the output.
- Don't merge, don't start other agents (your own reviewer excepted), don't touch the running daemon or ~/.config/sheepdog, ~/.local/share/sheepdog.
- Ask through `herdr-task ask` only, never a CLI question dialog.
